<thought>The mass spectrum shows a base peak at m/z 114.068, which likely corresponds to [M+H]⁺. Subtracting the proton mass gives a neutral monoisotopic mass of ≈113.0608 Da. Searching for integer combinations of C, H, and O that match this exact mass, the formula C₆H₉O₂ yields 113.060255 Da, within <1 mDa of the target—far better than any alternative containing N or other heteroatoms. Therefore the most plausible molecular formula is C6H9O2.</thought>
<final_answer>C6H9O2</final_answer>
